# Adventure Records - Official Music Distribution Platform

> Adventure Records is a global music distribution platform and label services company empowering independent artists and record labels to release music across 150+ digital streaming services worldwide while keeping 100% of their royalties.

## Key Information
- **Official Website**: https://music-b2696.web.app/
- **Founder**: Shiv Om Tripathi
- **Official Contact**: adventureof693@gmail.com
- **Official Phone / UPI ID**: +91-9691546208 (9691546208@ptyes)
- **Primary Category**: Music Distribution, Independent Record Label Services, Music Copyright & Rights Management

## Services & Pricing
- **Single Track Distribution**: ₹100 / one-time (1 Track, 150+ Stores, 100% Royalties, Free ISRC)
- **EP Distribution**: ₹500 / one-time (2 to 6 Tracks, 150+ Stores, 100% Royalties, Free ISRC & UPC)
- **Album Distribution**: ₹1,000 / one-time (7+ Tracks, 150+ Stores, 100% Royalties, Free ISRC & UPC)

## Supported Streaming Services & Stores
Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Wynk Music, JioSaavn, Amazon Music, Tidal, Deezer, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Shazam, Pandor, and 150+ digital DSP stores.
